summary:
Main release: teams/exml_rl = plan B, weight average of 94 snapshots (b1 updates 160–2030), sampled at temperature 0.7 — 87% wins on 640 held-out games; beats relay (52%, GD +1.38), balanced 67% (+1.86), guardian/chaos 84%, rusher/camper 92%, steady and provided bots 100%. Confirmed vs the previous release on two fresh seed sets: +1.37 and +1.35 GD per match.

Pure end-to-end release teams/exml_rl_pure: student re-distilled from the averaged main policy, weight-averaged (snapshots 350–450) at temperature 0.7 — 80% held-out (rusher 89%, chaos 88%, camper 78%, guardian 73%, balanced 41%, relay 38%); confirmed +1.64 / +1.45 GD vs the previous pure release on two fresh seed sets.

Final (27 Oct 20:41 IST): verified from a fresh clone of GitHub main — engine untouched, both reports PASS, official main.py matches, 187 tests pass.

runs.name: b1
runs.description: Plan B: heading/speed goal action space + physics controller; from scratch, kickstarted from relay (CE 1.0 fading over 300M); 9 workers.

updates.text: Exact simulator (bit-identical to engine), feature encoder, PPO trainer done; M2 training started on the training machine.
Phase 1 reviewed (2 critical reward bugs fixed). Exporter (M1) done: bit-exact, ~1 ms callbacks. Evaluation harness done. League + mirror self-play added. m2b training.
M2 learning: 3.2 goals/match vs idle at 38M samples. Review round 2 fixes in. Replay viewer added. Idle-bonus shaping artifact found and fixed.
M2 gate passed (8 goals/match vs idle). 7 strong scripted training opponents added. Review round 3 done. M3 (m3b) running. Merged another session's push to main without loss.
Replay analysis: our players far slower than scripted bots. Added a clear-ground memory map and ray inputs (features v2) with warm-start surgery; m3c running. GRU option built.
Features v2 (clear-ground rays) lifted baseline win rate 44%→78%. Review fixes (exact ray traversal etc.). Learner moved to GPU + pipelining: ~290M samples/h. m3d running.
m3d u300: baseline 94%, camper 22%, guardian/rusher 16%, relay 6%, balanced 3%. Replay vs relay: 7-14 (was 2-19).
Rollouts 1.43x faster (bit-identical, fixture-tested). Adaptive opponent mix on (shifts training toward relay/balanced etc.). m3d u450: baseline 97%, camper 25%, relay 9%, balanced 6%.
Plateau vs relay/balanced. Greedy decoding >> sampling. lr 1e-3 A/B worse. Capacity A/B (Net2Wider 256x256) running. Defence potential implemented.
Features v4 + fine throttle bins + defence potential + focused league curriculum. A/B on entropy/λ running (m4a/m4b).
m4b (low entropy, λ 0.99) wins the A/B. Release pipeline built; first candidate passes all checks. Feature registry + v5 memory features in progress.
m4c (lower entropy, higher λ) slightly beats m4b: guardian/rusher/camper ~50% held-out. v5 features + strict migration done (reviewed). A/B v5 vs v4 running. Releasing m4c as teams/exml_rl.
Released teams/exml_rl (m4c u210): 54% overall vs 10 bots; baseline 92%; latency p99 0.29 ms on a quiet machine.
v5 adopted (m5a). Replay vs relay: won 8-5 (was 2-19). Support-potential A/B (m5b) started to fix slow re-pickup (195 vs 51 ticks).

Surveys done: plateau confirmed; both rank kickstarting from relay #1. k1 kickstarting run vs m5b control running. Repo cleaned, single main branch, front page + gallery. Plan B (heading/speed + controller) being built.

Kickstarting in the bins action space failed (k1, k2). Paired A/B: m5b ≈ release (no progress in 10 h; worse vs guardian). Switched to the generalist league g1 from the release lineage; plan B (heading/speed action space) in development.
PLAN B BREAKTHROUGH: b1 (heading/speed + controller + relay kickstart) matched our best old model in 45 min from scratch, with 16x fewer wall deaths. All compute moved to b1.
Released plan B as teams/exml_rl: 72% held-out (from 54%). Pure-RL release kept as teams/exml_rl_pure. Distillation to a pure network in progress.
Relay progress flattening (~28%). Launched breakthrough work (relay-loss diagnosis, team-aware critic, targeted rewards) alongside b1 and the distillation track.

Memory leak fixed (b1 ~10 GB → <2 GB). Sweep of b1 snapshots: peak around u1120–u1600, then wall-death drift. Both releases now PASS (pure latency re-measured). training-machine work stops 06:25 IST; laptop-only afterwards.
Re-released teams/exml_rl = b1 u1440 at temperature 0.7: 81% held-out (from 72%); relay 39%, balanced 48%.

Released the distilled pure network as teams/exml_rl_pure: 67% held-out (from 54%). Fixed a ~15 ms first-call latency spike in sampled exports. Wall-death fine-tune and per-head temperature tested: no gain.
Released weight-averaged plan B (33 snapshots, u1120–1760) as teams/exml_rl: 83% held-out; relay 44% (GD positive for the first time), balanced 56%.
Deadline set: experiments freeze 21:30 IST, final releases and verification done by 23:30 (hard 23:59).
Released averaged plan B u160–2030 (87% held-out, relay 52% / +1.38) and averaged pure student at τ0.7 (71%). Both confirmed on two fresh seed sets.
Released the re-distilled pure network (d5, averaged u350–450, τ0.7): 80% held-out (from 71%). Experiments frozen.
Final verification passed from a fresh clone. Submissions final: teams/exml_rl (87%) and teams/exml_rl_pure (80%).
